trigger: River crossing. The ice breaks under the column.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: A crack like a rifle shot. The ice tilts. The supply sled slides toward black water.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: So does Cody, who was pulling it. You can reach one. Only one.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Your hand on his collar. The sled goes under, a winter of food with it. Cody is choking, alive.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: He coughs up river water and laughs, the scared laugh.

nodes.speaker: ray
nodes.text: ...Son. Hey. Hey. We're square. We're square, okay?

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You haul the sled back by the rope. When you look up, the hole is just black water.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Nobody says anything. Then someone has to keep walking, so everyone does.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: You throw yourself on the rope. The sled stops at the edge. Everyone breathes.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Across the swinging bridge: lights. The dam. Someone is standing at the gate.
